body:
This PR introduces a series of micro-UX and accessibility refinements to the Dopemux Ultra UI dashboard, focusing on keyboard discoverability and temporal grounding.

### 💡 What
- **Task Metadata Accessibility**: Individual task metrics (Complexity, Duration, Energy, and Finish Time) in the sequence list are now keyboard-focusable and have descriptive ARIA labels. This allows keyboard users to trigger tooltips and understand task context semantically.
- **Visual Focus Indicators**: Added custom `&:focus-visible` styles to metadata boxes to ensure focus visibility without relying on default browser outlines.
- **Stateful Iconography**: The current task icon now dynamically switches between a `Pause` icon (Saint Gold) when the ritual is paused and a pulsing `Play` icon (Ritual Cyan) when active.
- **Signal Feed Keyboard Nav**: Notification chips in the Live Signal Feed are now focusable, allowing keyboard users to navigate through the event stream.

### 🎯 Why
- **Keyboard Discoverability**: Supplemental task context was previously "trapped" in tooltips that only triggered on hover.
- **Temporal Grounding**: For users with ADHD, clear visual feedback on whether a "live" ritual is currently ticking or paused reduces cognitive uncertainty.
- **Accessibility Standards**: Aligns with WCAG 2.4.7 (Focus Visible) and ensures decorative or shorthand indicators provide full context to assistive technology.

### ♿ Accessibility
- Verified that all new focusable elements have appropriate ARIA labels.
- Ensured that `outline: none` is always accompanied by a clear `&:focus-visible` indicator.
- Updated `Accessibility.test.ts` to include coverage for these new patterns.

latestReviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Adds keyboard accessibility and visual-state refinements to the Dopemux Ultra UI dashboard: task metadata becomes keyboard-focusable with descriptive ARIA labels and explicit focus-visible styling, the current-task icon now toggles between an animated Play and a Pause icon based on timer state, and Live Signal Feed notification chips become focusable.

**Changes:**
- TaskSequencer metadata boxes (complexity/duration/energy/finish-time) become focusable with `aria-label` and custom `:focus-visible` rings.
- Current-task icon swaps to a `Pause` (Saint Gold) when `isTimerRunning` is false, retains pulsing `Play` (Ritual Cyan) when running.
- Notification chips in `App.tsx` made keyboard-focusable; `Accessibility.test.ts` updated to assert the new patterns.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ui-dashboard/src/components/TaskSequencer.tsx | Adds Pause/Play state toggle for current task icon; wraps metadata in focusable Boxes with ARIA labels and focus-visible styles. |
| ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx | Adds `tabIndex={0}` to signal-feed notification Chip for keyboard navigation. |
| ui-dashboard/src/components/__tests__/Accessibility.test.ts | String-based assertions for the new ARIA labels, focusability, and focus-visible styles. |
